movement_screen.description: Independent attachment-point sensitivity, not solved train motion or a hose route
movement_screen.limits: Declared study assumptions, not approved articulation limits. Fixed adjacent body; tender rotates at its pin in Rz(yaw) Ry(pitch) Rx(roll) order, then receives axial gap change. Excludes S-curves, coupled-train equilibrium, ports, fitting lengths, bend radius, twist, hose stretch, sag and collision.
